2 رَأَيْتُ فِى الأَرْضِ تَفْصِيدًا مِنَ السَّيْلِ means I saw, in the ground, a cleft, or furrowed, state, resulting from the torrent. (ISh, O, L, K. * [Here تَفْصِيدًا is a pass. inf. n., used as a subst.]) ―
-b2- And تَفْصِيدٌ, also, signifies The macerating [a thing] with a little water. (ADk, O, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
